title: Understanding Steem's Dual-Token System: STEEM vs SBD
body: Steem operates on a unique dual-token model that distinguishes it from many other blockchain platforms. The native STEEM token serves as the base currency for the network, while Steem Dollars (SBD) provide a stable-value medium for transactions and rewards. This dual-token system was designed to offer both volatility exposure and price stability to users. STEEM tokens are used for powering up, which increases your influence on the platform through stake weight. SBD, on the other hand, is pegged to the US dollar and can be converted back to STEEM at a roughly 1:1 ratio. Understanding how these tokens interact is fundamental to navigating the Steem ecosystem effectively. The system creates a dynamic where content creators can earn in either token depending on market conditions, while curators can benefit from both appreciation and curation rewards. This structure has been a defining feature of Steem since its inception, creating a distinct economic model within the blockchain space.
